novelty.justification: The claim proposes a mechanism/measurement contribution: “two partially separable internal channels—own-belief ... and attributed-belief” with attribution errors caused by “leakage from the own-belief channel into the attributed channel.” Searches using “LLM self versus other belief representations,” “mechanistic interpretability false belief egocentric bias,” “theory of mind belief probes activation steering,” and “own knowledge leakage attributed belief” identified Language Models Represent Beliefs of Self and Others as the closest representational precedent, while FANToM and SimpleToM establish behavioral failures under information asymmetry. The directional leakage hypothesis and own-belief-subspace ablation go beyond those works, but they are a natural extension that combines existing belief probing, known egocentric errors, and standard projection interventions rather than introducing a fundamentally new interpretability paradigm.
